Singapore region for global ticket buyers

ops.label: Cloud DNS
ops.why: 앱 도메인을 ESA 엣지 노드로 해석합니다.

ops.label: ESA
ops.why: DDoS 방어, 캐싱 및 동적 가속으로 API 응답을 최적화합니다.

ops.why: API 트래픽을 두 가용영역의 서버로 분산합니다.

ops.why: OWASP 공격 및 봇 트래픽을 차단합니다.

ops.label: TLS 인증서
ops.why: HTTPS 통신을 위한 TLS 인증서를 관리합니다.

ops.text: API 서버는 SAE로 구성하고, 세션은 Tair, 고객 데이터는 RDS에 저장하며 모두 이중 가용영역으로 배치합니다.

ops.label: API 서버

ops.label: KMS
ops.why: 데이터베이스 및 저장소 암호화 키를 안전하게 관리합니다.

ops.label: 문서 저장소
ops.why: 약관, 증명서 등 비정형 문서를 서울 리전에 보관합니다.

ops.label: NAT Gateway

turns.ask: We are building a ride-hailing platform in Indonesia. Customer data must stay in Indonesia and we want to avoid Kubernetes. Design the backend with an API gateway, about 8 microservices, a relational database and a cache.

ops.text: I'll design a ride-hailing backend in Jakarta using SAE for microservices (no Kubernetes), Cloud-native API Gateway, PolarDB and Tair.
Customer data must stay in Indonesia
Avoid Kubernetes
Public-facing mobile app
About 100k daily rides

ops.label: Rider & Driver Apps
ops.why: Mobile clients for riders and drivers calling the platform APIs.

ops.label: Cloud DNS
ops.why: Resolves the API domain to ESA edge nodes.

ops.label: ESA
ops.why: Accelerates API traffic and provides DDoS protection globally.

ops.label: API Gateway
ops.why: Routes, throttles and authenticates all incoming API requests.

ops.label: WAF
ops.why: Blocks OWASP attacks and malicious bots at the gateway.

ops.text: Eight microservices run on SAE, which scales containers without any Kubernetes management.

ops.label: User Service
ops.why: Manages rider and driver profiles and authentication.

ops.label: Driver Service
ops.why: Handles driver onboarding, documents and availability status.

ops.label: Ride Service
ops.why: Core engine for ride matching, dispatch and lifecycle.

ops.label: Fare Service
ops.why: Calculates dynamic pricing, surge multipliers and estimates.

ops.label: Payment Service
ops.why: Processes payments, e-wallets and refunds securely.

ops.label: Map Service
ops.why: Geocoding, routing and ETA calculations for rides.

ops.label: Notification Service
ops.why: Sends push notifications, SMS and in-app messages.

ops.label: Rating Service
ops.why: Stores and aggregates ride ratings and feedback.

ops.text: PolarDB stores relational data across two zones; Tair caches sessions and real-time driver locations.

ops.label: PolarDB MySQL
ops.why: Primary relational database with compute-storage separation for scale.

ops.label: Tair Cache
ops.why: In-memory cache for sessions, driver locations and fare configs.

ops.label: Object Storage
ops.why: Stores driver license photos and document uploads in Indonesia.

ops.label: NAT Gateway
ops.why: Provides outbound internet access for payment gateways and maps.

ops.label: Log Service
ops.why: Centralizes logs from all microservices for troubleshooting.
